description.narrative: Preparation of investment activities for the phase-out of HCFCs in RAC manufacturing sector UNIDO will have to undertake a comprehensive survey in the RAC sector to collect HCFC consumption data, ownership information, details on the produced products as well as baseline equipment. There is a need to hold several stakeholder consultation meetings with the industry and the involvement of the Government to design a proper strategy for this very complex sector. In cooperation with the Government of Brazil, industry and relevant bilateral and implementing agencies, a RAC sector strategy and investment projects will be prepared to help the Government of Brazil to achieve at least the 2020 reduction target in line with the priorities established in the HPMP.
